acceptance: The 7-day missing-verdict count is recorded before any edit.
If built: a test shows pr-arm dispatches once for a head with no verdict run and never for a head with one; a live dispatch is observed on a real PR.
context: Re-homed from the deferred 'verdict dispatch at pr-arm' step of the 2026-10-25 proposal.
description:
Deferred from the 2026-10-25 oracle proposal (second Advisor review, option d). make pr-arm already refreshes oracle-gate before arming (#3485). When no oracle-verdict run exists for the exact head (none queued, in progress or completed), pr-arm could dispatch `gh workflow run oracle-verdict.yml --ref develop -f pr=<n>` and report it, instead of leaving the author to wait for the hourly sweep.

Decision gate: build only if 7 days of data after oracle-verdict-single-job-20261025 lands show heads with no verdict run within 30 minutes of the push. Record the count first.

Guardrails: dispatch only from develop's ref; never more than one dispatch per head; no change to verdict trust, carry or the gate.
